body_markdown:
Our VoluNteer Days give N-ablites the opportunity to donate their time and talents to causes that matter to them and their communities. From lending a hand to learning new skills, every VoluNteer Day is a chance to make a meaningful difference.


In this VoluNteer Spotlight, we’re h **ighlighting Crystal Beck, Team Lead, Escalation Management** and her work with **Ashe County Habitat for Humanity** , where she rolled up her sleeves to help build a safe, affordable home for a local family.


## What organization did you volunteer with?


I volunteered with Ashe County Habitat for Humanity – they build safe, affordable homes for low-income families in our area, leveraging volunteers to help get the work done.


## What inspired you to support this organization?


I’ve volunteered with Habitat since 2023. I keep coming back because every hour spent volunteering helps a local family get closer to having a home of their own. I also learn something new every time I show up, and the people I work alongside make it worthwhile.


## What were your main responsibilities or activities during your VoluNteer Day?


We installed pipes in the house attic and walls. We also sealed attic gaps and the crawl space, waterproofed the bathroom tile backer board to get it ready for tiling, and helped build and level the scaffolding. That work helped make the home safe, energy efficient, and ready for the next stage of construction.


## Which N-able core value did you bring to life during your volunteer experience, and why?


N-rich Lives. Helping build a home for a family in my own community is about as direct as giving back gets, and I’m grateful N-able gives us paid VoluNteer Days to do it. It’s a benefit that says a lot about who we are as a company.


## Making an impact, one VoluNteer Day at a time


Crystal’s experience is a great example of what N-rich Lives looks like in action: giving your time, learning along the way, and making a tangible difference right in your own community.
We’re proud to celebrate N-ablites like Crystal who support the organizations and causes that matter to them.
